purpose: Separate runtime tool-call parser/template capability from free tool-selection behavior: require the first call through API, then auto continuation. No autonomy or recovery claim.
build: Release, GGML_CUDA=OFF, LLAMA_OPENSSL=OFF; server target, two compilation jobs
cases: if the call is correct, deliver synthetic READ_OK/running and request continuation
stopping: One preflight, no retries on errors or incorrect output. No model adjustment based on output. Preserve logs and raw requests even on failure.
measurement: Model and server hashes, command, props/template, raw requests/responses, canonical proposal, phase failure, cleanup and elapsed time. GPU VRAM is not a CPU measurement.
comparison: Only first tool_choice changes from auto to required. Original no-call response is preserved. A correct constrained call does not prove voluntary tool use.
